<function name="SetShouldDraw" parent="CNewParticleEffect" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Forces the particle system to stop automatically rendering.

Used in conjunction with <page>CNewParticleEffect:Render</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="should" type="boolean">Whether to automatically draw the particle effect or not.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
